name: CNX Resources

logo.source: en.wikipedia.org infobox logo (CNX Resources Corporation, Logo 2022.svg)

description: CNX produces natural gas in Appalachia, 92 percent gas and 8 percent liquids, from Marcellus and Utica Shale wells in Pennsylvania, West Virginia and Ohio plus coalbed methane in Virginia. It owns its own gathering pipelines (about 2,600 miles) and sells to marketers, utilities and power plants on short-term contracts at market prices, so gas price drives revenue, but it hedges heavily and the hedges often swing reported results: in 2025 a $170 million loss on Shale hedges was offset by a $278 million gain on 'Other' segment hedges. It also sells environmental attributes (credits for capturing waste mine methane, $77.8 million in 2025) and a little midstream and water service to third parties. It buys back stock aggressively and has paid no dividend since 2016.

hq.note: 1000 Horizon Vue Drive, Canonsburg, PA (FY2025 10-K cover page)

employees.note: Includes 44 in midstream and 54 in Virginia coalbed methane; no collective bargaining agreements (FY2025 10-K)

businessLines.name: Shale
businessLines.how: Sells gas (and a little NGL) at market prices, mostly on short-term contracts to marketers, industrial users, utilities and power generators, through its own gathering system; revenue is volume times local Appalachian price, adjusted by hedge results, and the cost base is fixed (DD&A plus gathering and transport).
businessLines.description: Marcellus and Utica Shale gas in PA, WV and OH: about 557,000 net Marcellus acres and 612,000 net Utica acres (341,000 overlap); 8.84 Tcfe of proved reserves; 665 net producing wells; 18.9 net development wells drilled in 2025. Includes midstream revenue of $69.2M.

businessLines.name: Coalbed Methane (CBM)
businessLines.how: Sells gas from existing coalbed methane wells at market prices (no new CBM drilling in 2025; segment capex $44.6M); the mine-gas capture also generates tradable environmental credits that are booked in 'Other'.
businessLines.description: Virginia coalbed methane from the Pocahontas #3 seam on about 283,000 net acres, plus captured remediated mine gas; 0.81 Tcfe of proved reserves; 3,784 net producing wells; no new drilling.

operatingProfit.note: Hedge losses and $59.2M of DD&A; FY2024 revenue $125.8M

businessLines.name: Other (shallow oil and gas, hedges, purchased gas, environmental attributes, corporate)
businessLines.how: Mostly accounting items rather than a business: the mark-to-market on the company-wide hedge book is booked here, plus fees on purchased and resold gas and the sale of carbon and renewable-energy credits generated by capturing waste methane from coal mines.
businessLines.description: Nominal shallow oil and gas; commodity derivative results; resale of purchased third-party gas ($45.3M); sales of environmental attributes ($77.8M); corporate interest ($170.6M) and other costs.

brands.name: CNX Midstream Partners LP (CNXM)
brands.segment: Gathering subsidiary inside the Shale segment (not guaranteeing CNX debt; has its own $400M 4.75% notes due 2030 and a revolver)
brands.share: Shale segment includes $69.2M of midstream revenue (3.1% of consolidated)

brands.name: Apex Energy II assets (acquired 2025-01-27)
brands.segment: Shale (southwestern Pennsylvania/West Virginia gas and midstream)
brands.share: Purchased for about $518M cash; revenue not separately reported
